HRA Analysis: ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6) secured a good run last time out and was running on late into third. She has good manners and with another good beginning she should settle close from the 10m handicap and should run another honest race. BLACK VIPER (11) continues to do things wrong in his races which has been his undoing throughout this campaign. He was very good five starts ago running into second behind Buster Dan and if he can put in a similar effort to that he should be hard to beat in this race. LOCHINVAR SON (5) is a consistent performer that’s never too far away. He ran well again behind Moreep last time out when sitting without cover and battling on well there. CROOKWELL EYES (7) did things wrong in his latest outing before trialling up well in a trial taken out by Speak The Truth. If he can bring his best manners he looks one of the hardest to beat in this race despite starting off a 20m handicap. SELECTIONS: ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6), BLACK VIPER (11), LOCHINVAR SON (5), CROOKWELL EYES (7) SUGGESTED BET: LOCHINVAR SON (5) to win.

SHARDS ECLIPSE (4) trialled up smartly recently leading all the way at this track rating fast time for the grade. She draws to settle in a prominent position in this race and should be hard to beat from there. CLAUDES DESIRE (3) has gate speed and may look to press forward and find a prominent position in this race from a good draw. He led two starts ago and was just run down by Skip To Me Lou late who has since run well again. HEZA DIRTY DANCER (1) sat without cover last time out at Redcliffe and was beaten a long way there. He draws well this time and with the benefit of that first up run he can run a better race this time. ROCKY WINE (6) was shuffled back last time out before making a wide run into it finishing fourth behind Bettor Cheer. She may be shuffled back again and should be running on late. SELECTIONS: SHARDS ECLIPSE (4), CLAUDES DESIRE (3), HEZA DIRTY DANCER (1), ROCKY WINE (6) SUGGESTED BET: SHARDS ECLIPSE (4) to win.

VINKE BE (2) showed enough gate speed to be the first horse down on the pegs before taking cover behind Barracuda who was able to lead all the way. He draws well again in this race and should be hard to run down. O B LEGAL (1) has very good gate speed and should have the speed to lead before having options from there. He finished fifth two starts ago at Redcliffe behind Major Crunch but was finishing the race off as well as anything there when not beaten far. BELLISIMO ACQUISTO (4) secured a good run off the speed and was running on late there behind Protagonist. He comes into this race second up and is likely to have derived good benefit from his first up outing. AMAMI (8) should get a good run in this race just behind the speed on the pegs. He looked to be quite unlucky last time out when getting back and running on strongly late. SELECTIONS: VINKE BE (2), O B LEGAL (1), BELLISIMO ACQUISTO (4), AMAMI (8) SUGGESTED BET: O B LEGAL (1) each way.

QUEEN TIDE (3) made a break first up from a spell last time out at Marburg. She moves back to a track which she has won three races at and draws well on the front row. If she can work her way to the lead early she is likely to be hard to run down. BETTOR BE BOHDI (1) has good gate speed which should allow him to drive through and lead in this race before having options from there. He has become somewhat of a professional place getter recently having recorded 11 placings since his latest victory. He should run well again and does appear close to another win. LONGSHOT (5) led and set a strong tempo last time out over the 2138 at this track before being run down late by Powermove. He may need to do some work again in this race but is in good form and should run well again. STAY DREAMY (8) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely early leader BETTOR BE BOHDI (1). She has been racing well and should be suited by a soft run on the pegs just behind the speed in this race. SELECTIONS: BETTOR BE BOHDI (1), LONGSHOT (5), STAY DREAMY (8) SUGGESTED BET: BETTOR BE BOHDI (1) to win.

ROSIE POLLEN (9) should get a good run off the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. She got back last time out and was running on nicely late into second behind The Real Rocketman. BOLD PERSONALITY (8) should get a good run through in this race behind a horse which is likely to be keen to hold a forward position in this race. She ran a good second two starts ago closing strongly at this track behind Man Of Action. TEACHERS PET (1) has good gate speed and finds a suitable race here. She got back in the run last time out and couldn’t get into it in a race taken out by Specialandiknowit. TAKE A CHANCE (4) raced behind the leader last time out at Redcliffe and was well beaten there. He seems to do his best work at this track up on speed and can look to bounce back in his second run for his new stable. SELECTIONS: ROSIE POLLEN (9), BOLD PERSONALITY (8), TEACHERS PET (1), TAKE A CHANCE (4) SUGGESTED BET: BOLD PERSONALITY (8) to win.

MAJOR SLIP UP (2) may be able to press through early in this race and find the lead from a good draw. He led two starts ago and rated good time for the grade there leading all the way. He looks hard to beat. ITS A SPONGE DARL (4) was able to run a good race last time out when sitting without cover and battling on well for second behind Vodka En Ice. He may be left to do the work again in this race but should run well off his latest effort. MAYWYNS ACE (8) draws awkwardly inside the back row in this race behind a horse which isn’t likely to be favoured in this race. He got back in the run last time out and was running on nicely late at Redcliffe into second behind Tiger Tommy. FRENCH BUBBLES (7) appeared to be well placed last time out in a race she made a break taking her out of play there. She draws wide this time and may be shuffled back and will need the race run to suit. SELECTIONS: MAJOR SLIP UP (2), ITS A SPONGE DARL (4), MAYWYNS ACE (8), FRENCH BUBBLES (7) SUGGESTED BET: MAJOR SLIP UP (2) to win.

SKIP TO ME LOU (7) secured a good run behind the leader last time out over the 2138 at this track and was able to battle away well for fourth behind Shades Of Miki and Move It Lou. He draws widest this time but drops a long way back in grade and should find this a lot easier. FRANCO MACHO (1) has good gate speed and shouldn’t be too far away early in this race from an ideal draw. He was shuffled back last time out before running on strongly when not beaten far behind Bigbashash. ALL EYES ON BLING (3) has good gate speed and should be able to work across to the lead early before having options from there. She has been racing well without quite being able to break through for a win and ran well again last time out finishing second behind Bigbashash. A PERFECT DANCE (8) should get a good run through early in this race behind a gate speed horse in FRANCO MACHO (1). She made a wide run into it late last time out and wasn’t beaten far in a similar race to this one. SELECTIONS: SKIP TO ME LOU (7), FRANCO MACHO (1), ALL EYES ON BLING (3), A PERFECT DANCE (8) SUGGESTED BET: SKIP TO ME LOU (7) to win. OVERVIEW:SHEZALOVER (2) is backing up from Tuesday night, when she showed good gate speed to find the top and gave plenty of fight to finish 4th in a field that looked slightly stronger than what she meets here. There's been merit in all three runs for the new camp, and if she can get reasonable control over the short trip, she will take plenty of running down. FONDA RHONDA (5) creates interest first up from a break, having won a recent trial against a pacing stablemate. Last season, she strung together some nice performances in Sydney, beating stronger opposition. She's without a placing this season, but her best form has her right in it. MAJESTIC CHARMA (6) is enjoying a good season and has a particular liking for her home track, winning four from nine here. She will likely press forward, and while her map appears a little uncertain, her ability against this line-up cuts through. APRIL SUN (1) has mixed his form and manners a bit this season, but the inside draw and a slight drop in class could see an improved performance, so he's worth keeping safe. SELECTIONS:SHEZALOVER (2), FONDA RHONDA (5), MAJESTIC CHARMA (6), APRIL SUN (1)

OVERVIEW:MAJOR MAURIE (2) has his first start for the new stable and has had one winning trial. Although he beat a trotter in moderate time, he did dash well at the end of it. He's well drawn to use his speed and either kick up to hold the front or at least find the leader's back. Despite needing fitness, he can return to winning form over the short trip. THE REGULATOR (8) won from the same draw at St Arnaud last start, where he finished off well along the passing lane in a moderate last half. He has a good record at this track, but his winning chances depend on whether he can map better than three pegs. SPUN SILVER (5) is the one who will have the most say in the speed map, regularly being a go-forward type who looks for the lead, particularly over the short trip. Her time capabilities may leave her vulnerable, but she'll be in it for a long way. CARUSO STAR (9) won't be able to display his gate speed, but the trailing draw in what looks a suitable grade gives him claims, while BANGBANG BOBBIE (10) and BONA KHAN (11) have tough draws to overcome but have minor claims if things work out. BACK: MAJOR MAURIE (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MAJOR MAURIE (2), THE REGULATOR (8), SPUN SILVER (5), CARUSO STAR (9)

OVERVIEW:GOZO MAJOR (5) is a horse who seems to cruise at the same speed from start to finish and can look beaten, only to keep coming when the others are tiring. That was the case in his last win, where he was three wide for the trip, was last at the 200m and kept grinding away to win. The time capabilities are limited with many here, so the distance and tempo may work in his favour. BETA THAN LOVE (1) has been costly and hasn't won for over a year, but he keeps getting positive draws to map well with top drivers, so he's always popular in the market. He has the speed to either try to hold the lead or take cover, which may be the more likely option over the longer trip, and look to sprint-lane victory. ARRAPS (4) will be one going forward and is racing well despite managing only one win this season. If he happens to roll to the top, his chances will dramatically improve. BOND GIRL (8) draws softly, is a winner at this track and is often around the placegetters. If they happen to overcook things up front, she could be the beneficiary. ROCKNROLL RAMBO (3) finds a good draw and is getting closer but is winless this season, while FREAK OUT (9) drops in grade, likes this track and could be an improver. SELECTIONS:GOZO MAJOR (5), BETA THAN LOVE (1), ARRAPS (4), BOND GIRL (8)

OVERVIEW:ROSBERG (1) appears well suited from the favourable draw to utilise his early gate speed, find the lead and control proceedings over the short trip. He's capable of running good times in stronger races than the opposition he faces here and comes off a narrow loss at Melton, where he found the line well in a sprint home. If he finds the top, he will take plenty of catching. ALL THINGS SPICY (8) appears fast enough to catch the leader's back should the pole marker hold up and was a winner from that position two runs back at this track. She's been racing well against quality opposition and looks a threat again. CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (3) is still a maiden but won't be for long on the back of consistent performances at this track and a strong SP profile. Chris Alford jumps on for the first time. LIBERTY STAR DUST (5) did things wrong last start, but her form prior was good, so she needs to be kept safe. I SEE RED (6) and EXOTIC CHESTER (9) would be strong winning chances on their best form, but their latest efforts are a slight query. BACK: ROSBERG (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ROSBERG (1), ALL THINGS SPICY (8), EXOTIC CHESTER (9), CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (3)

OVERVIEW: A lovely group of 3yo trotting fillies headed by Oaks winner, IJUSTCANTSEEIT (3), who caused a major upset in winning that G1 but has since backed up that terrific performance with an unlucky 4th behind the boys in the Derby, rattling to the line when clear. She gets the barrier draw advantage over her main rivals here to press forward, although the opposition remains strong. ALDEBARAN ADA (8) has been respected at the top end of the market in many of her races yet hasn't been able to recapture the same zest that saw her win a rich feature at Wagga back in May. Her best is certainly good enough, so she must be kept safe. ADELAIDE RED (5) is a G1 winner herself and has been racing well, often taking on A-grade company. It's no easier here, but she must be respected. MEVIA (4) ran a better race last time, beating a few of these, so a repeat performance with Herbertson booked keeps her under notice. BACK: IJUSTCANTSEEIT (3) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:IJUSTCANTSEEIT (3), ALDEBARAN ADA (8), ADELAIDE RED (5), MEVIA (4)

OVERVIEW:CHINSKI (3) gets a nice draw to return to the winners' list. It was a similar marble that saw a win in September, when the lead was narrowly missed despite an early burn, before finding enough to come again and win. In similar grade two runs back, Chinski carried a flat tyre and does have a liking for this track and distance. SUZS DREAM (2) has won two of her last five and can show gate speed from this draw to map positively. She's having her first look at this track, with the only concern being that she often races better over a bit longer. WALKING ON WATER (4) is still a maiden, but she gives every indication a win isn't too far away. She's been runner-up at her past four runs and can work in her races, which is encouraging if she doesn't get the top or cover. ATEGO DAWN (1) gets the inside draw, and her last win came when she was able to lead from the same marble earlier this year. She's first up off one trial with fitness to come but keep her safe. MASSIF CENTRAL (6) can come out well, although I'm not sure he can cross. If he does, he comes into calculations. SELECTIONS:CHINSKI (3), SUZS DREAM (2), WALKING ON WATER (4), ATEGO DAWN (1)

OVERVIEW: A mix of debutantes and 2yos, 3yos and 4yos at maiden level. MISTER THREEOFFIVE (8) presents as the most likely candidate, with a base of solid trial form and maturity. He was sent out an odds-on favourite at Wagga, only narrowly going down in a time that should cover most of these. He should be winning, and hopefully the draw allows a price to bet. HILLCROFT HUSTLER (4) is a 3yo having a third start and was good when sitting parked in a solid race, having previously finished 2nd behind a smart one in a sprint home. The barrier draw advantage is in his favour. BANIA (7) came through that same race at Melton last time, producing an improved effort to finish 4th. He had a solid SP profile prior off the trials, so despite the draw, he can run a race. They seem to be the major players, with IDEAL HIGH (2) and I AM MOLLY (3) chances for the minor money, while PACEMAKER (5) is a 2yo who gives away experience, but any market moves should be respected. BACK: MISTER THREEOFFIVE (8) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:MISTER THREEOFFIVE (8), HILLCROFT HUSTLER (4), BANIA (7), I AM MOLLY (3)

OVERVIEW: A wide finish to the Quaddie, with most of these either racing well or finding the right class level. HARLEY LANE (4) is a 4yo mare who's taken on some smart ones in her age group throughout her career. She resumed with a win in a winnable race but looked good in doing so. Herbertson will look to use her speed to get into a positive map, and with added fitness, she'll be hard to beat. MISTER AMERICANO (2) finds a good draw but doesn't have a lot of gate speed. He raced well sitting tough in a stronger race last time at Melton and prior was a winner in decent time. ROM BARO (6) has proven himself to be a more than handy type, taking on smart ones of his age group and then often winning when he drops back to easier grade. The draw means he may have to do work, but he's equal to the task. CYCLONE JENNI (5) loves this track, building a nice record, but now finds a more challenging affair. She's hard to knock on what she's been producing, however. They seem to be the major players, with ILLAWONG PHOENIX (1) and ELIZAJANE (7) chances with the right runs, while SEA FURY (8) is one I've had on top in tougher races than this, but I want to see him produce something before there's any confidence. SELECTIONS:HARLEY LANE (4), MISTER AMERICANO (2), ROM BARO (6), CYCLONE JENNI (5)

OVERVIEW: A mix of ages and experience here, with 2yos, 3yos and older horses, so it's a little tricky to line them up. LANIKAI WARRIOR (1) is a 2yo who ran good time and looked strong in winning last time out at Wagga. He showed good gate speed to lead there, so the draw and distance are in his favour to go back-to-back. MISSMALACHITE (8) doesn't win out of turn, but she does have the speed to hold the polemarker's back and has experience on her side. Her best performances are when she leads, so behind the leader looks an appealing position. MATRIARCH DAISY (3) has gate speed, and she may be going better than her form suggests, having taken on a couple of smart ones lately. She's open to improvement. They seem to be the major chances, with LETS HIT IT (4), ZEE HOUTEN (5) and SWEET LADY LOU (6) all coming off last-start wins but striking a decent line-up here. SELECTIONS:LANIKAI WARRIOR (1), MISSMALACHITE (8), MATRIARCH DAISY (3), SWEET LADY LOU (6)

The two-year-old fillies come together in what looks a strong race. DANGER BEWARE (7) has been super impressive in both her runs so far and will again look to be storming home strongly from back in the field, where you would expect her to settle from the outside front-row draw. KOOKY (9) draws the back row for the first time, having led in all three starts since arriving back in the state. She follows out a handy beginner in IDEN JUST BECAUSE (2), who hasn't been far away in recent feature races against some of these fillies, so should find at worst a midfield position and get her chance to again be in the finish. ANN PENNY (8) is another who draws the back row for the first time since arriving from New Zealand but has shown good speed at both ends of her races thus far. With some tempo throughout and a good drive, you would expect her to be just as competitive coming from behind. BABY CHARLOTTE (5) got the gaps when needed last start at Burnie when a short-priced favourite and looks to be improving with every start. She was a handy second after doing all the work at her previous start, so will be looking to take advantage of her front-row draw ahead of her main dangers. VINJETTA (3) is still yet to break her maiden despite putting together some strong performances and again gets her chance from the nice draw, while SOUL OF KARALTA (6) could be the one at odds if she is able to utilise her sharp gate speed to find the pegs, as she did two starts back. Selections: DANGER BEWARE (7), KOOKY (9), BABY CHARLOTTE (5), ANN PENNY (8) Staking Strategy: DANGER BEWARE looks the class horse of the field, and although she's a fairly skinny price, she may drift out late to closer to double your money. 3 unit win – DANGER BEWARE (7).

The first heat of the Dynamo Series kicks off, where there looks to be speed aplenty from some well-drawn runners. SOHO TIGER LILY (3) will be doing her best to get to the pegs, where she can run a very sharp mile when on song. However, WEE GEORGIE WOOD (2) and OUR WILLOW (1) also possess excellent gate speed, so the pressure could be on early, with all three racing very well and consistently of late. The beneficiary of that early speed could be KARALTA ARTEMIS (7), who has really hit his straps at his past three starts when driven with a sit and coming with one run late. In the smallish field, he should get his chance to do something similar here. ITSMENOTU (4) hasn't been far away in her two starts since resuming from a break and, although rising slightly in class, can't be left out of exotics. MR BONDI (6) looks the best of the rest and could be running home strongly off a solid tempo, with the mile distance suiting him where he does his best racing. Selections: KARALTA ARTEMIS (7), SOHO TIGERLILY (3), WEE GEORGIE WOOD (2), OUR WILLOW (1) Staking Strategy: KARALTA ARTEMIS should enjoy the small field and the expected good tempo from the get-go, so he'll get his chance to be running over the top again here. 2 unit win – KARALTA ARTEMIS (7).

COLORADO GIRL (1) has been hit and miss since arriving in the state but looks to get her chance here from the pole draw over the short distance. Although she has been driven more quietly of late, she does possess very sharp gate speed from the mobile start, so expect connections may use that to their advantage here and attempt an all-the-way victory. Stablemate TWILIGHT BEACH (5) has hit the line well at her past two starts and will no doubt look to do something similar again from the middle front-row draw, where she should find a midfield position. STANTON BREAK (2) and GOBSMACKED (8) should position close to the speed with cover and get their chance over the final furlong. COOLANDCOLLECT 4) has been racing well without winning and only needs a good run in transit to be storming over the top of them late if at his best. Selections: COLORADO GIRL (1), TWILIGHT BEACH (3), COOLANDCOLLECT (4), GOBSMACKED (8) Staking Strategy: TWILIGHT BEACH looks the small each-way play of the race. 1 unit each-way – TWILIGHT BEACH (5).

The lowest-rated heat of the night looks to have gate speed aplenty off the front row, where CAPTAIN CHEDDAR (3), AWAY GAME (4) and FIVE STAR SHARK (5) all possess very good gate speed, and expect they will look to use it here. However, all three would need to improve on recent performances to be winning. DANCINWIVJOLENE (2) hasn't been far away of late and should get a nice soft run just behind the speed from her ideal draw. SWEET AMOUR (6) and NO NUKES SKIPPER (7) will be relying on that early tempo to allow them to run home strongly into the finish, where they could take some holding out late. Selections: DANCINWIVJOLENE (2), SWEET AMOUR (6), NO NUKES SKIPPER (7), FIVE STAR SHARK (5) Staking Strategy: With numerous horses with good gate speed engaged, SWEET AMOUR should get a chance to be running home strongly again here. 2 unit win – SWEET AMOUR (6).

The highest-class heat of the night, where you would somewhat expect the fastest mile rate to come from. IMPERIAL LAZ (3) will be attempting to use his gate speed to get to the pegs in what looks a somewhat tricky speed map off the front row. At his best, he can run a very sharp mile and would be hard to run down. MUZZAME MATE (2) gets the nice draw and has sufficient gate speed to find a good position on speed. He deserves to break through after a string of strong performances. IDEN LADY LINCOLN (5) does her best racing on speed when driven tough, and expect connections may employ similar tactics here, which should ensure a strongly run race and allow every horse to get their chance. She will have to try to stave off the challengers late. ANGEL ROCKS (1) gets the pole draw to her advantage but would need to improve on her disappointing first-up effort. Selections: MUZZAME MATE (2), IDEN LADY LINCOLN (5), IMPERIAL LAZ (3), ANGEL ROCKS (1) Staking Strategy: MUZZAME MATE should get a nice sit on speed and get his chance to break through for a deserved victory. 2 unit win – MUZZAME MATE (2).

I found this race the hardest to assess of the night. THEE OLD BOMB (5) returns to the front row and can run the gate like no other when allowed. With no other standout gate speed horses off the front row, he should be first to the pegs and get his chance to run a sneaky race at odds. ALBERIO (6) also possesses good gate speed when asked and, although drawn wider, expect he should have enough speed to get across most of those inside him and hopefully find a nice position on speed. OLLIES MEDAL (8) would benefit from some good tempo throughout, which would allow him to settle better, and could be the knockout horse at odds as the lone backmarker. DOLCE DRAMA (7) is threatening to break through after some handy performances of late but draws the outside gate. DENNY (3) looks the most consistent of the other three Wayne Yole-trained pacers from their nice draws, in what looks a very difficult race where any runner could bob up and win. Selections: THEE OLD BOMB (5), ALBERIO (6), OLLIES MEDAL (8), DOLCE DRAMA (7) Staking Strategy: Absolute raffle this race, so a very small each-way bet on THEE OLD BOMB, who should be first to the pegs. 0.5 unit win, 1 unit place – THEE OLD BOMB (5).

STONE WRITER (1) returns to racing after a 12-month break and comes up with the pole draw on resumption. He trialled very nicely on Monday at Hobart and, if he puts his best foot forward, expect he may take some beating here. TALK IS CHEAP (5), you would expect, may have a crack for the front early using her good gate speed and is suited over the mile, as is COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (2), who draws the ideal gate to find a nice position on speed. Another race where it wouldn't surprise to see any horse pop up and win, including EYE SEE AMOUR (6), who has been running home well of late, and the old girl QUEENOFDANCE (8), who loves sitting off the back of a hot tempo and running home strongly. Selections: STONE WRITER (1), TALK IS CHEAP (5), COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (2), QUEENOFDANCE (8) Staking Strategy: If he puts his best foot forward, STONE WRITER should be making a winning return from a lengthy break. 2 unit win – STONE WRITER (1).

Another race where there looks to be some nice gate speed off the front row, with MAXX (1) looking to kick through and hold the front, where he should be suited over the mile. REPETITIVE (3) looks the one most likely to push the button when the green light comes on and has been racing consistently of late. JUST LIKA DREAM (2) has been racing well without winning and should find a nice position on speed with cover, giving her every chance to finish in the top three again here. CHEYS ANGEL (5) will be hoping for plenty of tempo throughout to allow her to rush home strongly, which she is capable of doing with the right run in transit. ROCKNALLOVERTHEWORLD (4) looks the best of the rest from his reasonable middle front-row draw. Selections: MAXX (1), JUST LIKA DREAM (2), CHEYS ANGEL (5), REPETITIVE (3) Staking Strategy: He may have to do a little bit of work early to hold the front, but MAXX should be suited over the mile running even quarters. 3 unit win – MAXX (1).

The final heat of the night, where although you would expect ALOT LIKE PENDLES (3) to go around at a very short price, I expect him to have to do a power of work sitting outside SHADES OF SILK (1), who possesses very good gate speed and should run them along at a very even tempo throughout. This should set it up for an enthralling finish for those watching the clock at the end of the race. It's hard to spot too many others capable of knocking off the favoured runners from their ideal draws, but ALWAYS AURORA (5) enjoys the mile distance and sitting off a hot speed, while MONTGOMERY BURNS (6) has been thereabouts of late and can't be left out of trifecta calculations. STEPUPANDANCE (2) will also be looking to run into the top three from her nice draw. Selections: ALOT LIKE PENDLES (3), SHADES OF SILK (1), ALWAYS AURORA (5), MONTGOMERY BURNS (6) Staking Strategy: The short-priced favourite looks hard to beat here, but happy to have an okay place bet on ALWAYS AURORA, who should be suited by the hot speed over the mile. 2 unit place – ALWAYS AURORA (5). NORMY (11) is racing well without winning at the moment. His last two second placing efforts have been strong. He will need some luck from the draw but he looks ready to win and he is worth strong consideration. NEDS BEACH (10) was an impressive winner on Monday here at Globe Derby when he defeated WEREGOINGTOGETCHA by 1.6 metres. A repeat of that run will put him right in the mix tonight. LOCHINVAR RULER (5) and MAJOR LINCOLN (7) are also chances.

NOTHING I WANT (4) galloped in the concluding stages of her race on Monday where it looked like she was going to win. She should find the lead tonight and if she can trot smoothly she should be hard to catch. BUCKLES (6), LOW LIE THE FIELDS (7) and EMILY MEAGAN (3) are all big chances.

HEZ SO ROYAL (10) has a tricky draw to overcome but he is a big time performer and he knows how to win a feature race. He will be extremely dangerous with Ryan Hryhorec in the sulky and he looks like the one to beat tonight. SRIRACHA (1) has a terrific draw after a strong win in the heats on Saturday night. He is a major chance of leading all of the way. TREACHEROUS DAN (5) and LE GASTON (8) are also big chances.

SANDLETON (6) was an impressive winner in the heats last week when she defeated HILLTOP STAR by 2.5 metres. She is a big chance again tonight. HILLTOP BLOSSOM (10) is a talented filly but tonight is the toughest draw she has received in ages. She is a big chance despite this but this will be the hardest she has had to work for a while. HILLTOP STAR (3) and PARVATI (4) are also chances.

HEZROCKINROYALTY (6) is the best horse in this race when he is right. He finds an easier race today compared to recent starts and he should be very hard to beat with Ryan Hryhorec in the sulky. SPLASH OF PAYNT (1) was run down last week in an easier race but if he can dictate the tempo a bit better this week then he will be a strong chance of leading all of the way. CLASSIC LINE (8) and CLARENDEN TRIBUTE (9) are also chances.

LAMBRO LOUELLA (4) is developing into a nice filly after she has won her last three starts. She defeated SAL WESTER by 36.2 metres last start in her heat. She looks very hard to beat tonight. WITHA BITTA LUCK (3) has won her first two starts. She is still learning the ropes but she is a big danger tonight. KENZINGTON (2) and MY ROCKING HORSE (5) look the next best.

CASTERTON (7) was extremely impressive in the Golden Nursery a few weeks back when he defeated CHAMPAGNE PROBLEMS by a half neck. He looks a class above this field. AUSTON (6) will be a big danger if he can improve off his tricky Melton runs, CHAMPAGNE PROBLEMS (9) and ONE AUSSIE (3) look the next best.

OMNIA (1) has a massive motor when she is right. The inside draw should help her immensely tonight. She looks like the one to beat. IDEOLOGY (5) has a lot of ability but he was disappointing last start in a race he should have won. HELPISFARAWAY (2) and JILLIBY BLISS (4) are also chances.

LUSTROUS (6) was fired up last start and was eventually run down by CASH ME UP. If he can trot smoothly and calm himself down a bit more in the run today he will be hard to beat. CASH ME UP (4) has won two of her three starts and keeps getting the job done. She is a massive chance again tonight. SEAPARADEGIRLIE (1) and SISTER STEPH (3) look the next best.

BERSAGLIERE (3) was run down by BAY LA VILLE on Wednesday at Port Pirie. He had a lot of pressure on him during the run and still hit the line well. He is a big chance tonight in this sort of race. FIRESIDE (6) is a big threat after a strong win on Monday. SPIRIT OF SPITFIRE (2) has her first Australian start. Her two trials at Menangle were disappointing. She has won a race in New Zealand though so it may pay to watch her market moves tonight. IMA TIGGY TIGER (5) looks the next best. FEEL THE MOMENT (6) finds a nice race today. She ran second behind PROHIBITED BID last start. She is racing well without winning and today looks like the day she will bounce back into the winners list. PROHIBITED BID (4) was a strong winner last start but the stand start will be a bit trickier for her today. NO REMORSE (2) and TINEY (1) are also chances.

TEN EAGLES (2) is first up from a spell today but today looks like his sort of race. If he is anywhere near his best he should be very hard to beat. LOW LIE THE FIELDS (7), EMILY MEAGAN (1) and WYLDCAT (4) are also chances.

TUFFASNAILS (7) has won his last four starts. He defeated HAPPY AS CAN BE by 6.9 metres last start. The draw will be tricky for him but he does look very hard to beat. ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (2) has won three of his last five starts and he was impressive last start when he defeated GUEST ARTIST by 5.3 metres. GUEST ARTIST (6) and ALWAYSBEALADY (4) are also big chances.

LAMBRO BAY (1) has been showing signs of improvement over his last few starts. He ran third behind FIRESIDE last start. He finds a much easier race today along with the inside draw. He should be hard to beat. VINNIES HOPE (2), GRACIOUS GODDESS (6) and MY GIRL MIA (5) are also chances.

JAWSOFGOODTIME (5) has won three of her last four starts and she is a good chance of leading today. If she can get to the lead early she should be hard to catch. PERFECT PLAYGIRL (8) was very disappointing last start but her runs before that were strong. It may pay to keep her safe. She has won two of her last four which is very strong form in a race like this. ASHANTE PRINCE (6) and WEREGOINGTOGETCHA (1) are also chances.

RESURRECTS (9) made up a lot of late ground last start where he ran second behind A MAJOR STARR. He hit the line so well and he just looks like he is aching to win a race. He is a major chance today even with the second row draw. SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (1), A MAJOR STARR (5) and DIDMESELFAMISCHIEF (4) are all big chances.

NORMY (3) is a major chance from the draw in this sort of race. He has been running around the mark recently and it may pay to look at how he ran on Saturday night as a guide. SEASIDE SHOW (4), STORMY MADEM (9) and LIGHTNING BLING (2) are also chances.

NIGHT SPIRIT (6) has won two of his last three starts and he has been rejuvenated since joining the Tony Pullicino stable. He looks like a major threat again today. OHSO KINKY (4) was an impressive winner last start at Port Pirie when she defeated WINSTON ALEXANDER by 6.3 metres. Today will be tougher but she is well drawn. WHATA OPTIMIST (9) and TWIN CONNECTION (7) are also big dangers.

SEA HUNTER (1) ran second behind MANDS PEARL last start. He is getting fitter with each run he has this preparation. He should be able to lead all of the way from the inside draw today. PARISIAN BANDIT (11), CAPTAINS DREAM (5) and ORAMA (8) are also chances.
HILLTOP STAR (5) looks extremely hard to beat in a much easier today. Her stable and driver must be given respect. CAPTAIN MOCKA (6), MY ULTIMATE BANJO (7) and CAPTAIN CAROLINE (1) are also chances.

CHASE THE STARS (2) has stand start experience and he is very well drawn today. He is a good chance of leading if he can step away cleanly. If he leads he will be very hard to catch. LOCHINVAR MAGIC (6) looks like the main danger. POWER UP (5) and WATCHMEDAZZLE (4) look the next best.
